description: Golden Q&A pairs for KnowledgeFlow vector and GraphRAG evaluation

cases.question: What is compound interest and how does it differ from simple interest?
cases.reference_answer: Compound interest grows on the principal plus interest already earned, while simple interest only grows on the original principal.

cases.question: What is the Rule of 72?
cases.reference_answer: The Rule of 72 estimates doubling time by dividing 72 by the annual interest rate in percent.

cases.question: What is diversification in investing?
cases.reference_answer: Diversification means spreading money across assets to reduce risk from any single failure.

cases.question: Why is spaced repetition better than cramming?
cases.reference_answer: Spaced repetition reviews material at increasing intervals to move facts into long-term memory, unlike cramming.

cases.question: What is active recall as a study technique?
cases.reference_answer: Active recall means closing the book and explaining the concept aloud or on paper to strengthen memory.

cases.question: What pattern defines a major scale?
cases.reference_answer: A major scale follows whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half (W-W-H-W-W-W-H).

cases.question: What notes make up a major triad?
cases.reference_answer: A major triad contains the 1st, 3rd, and 5th degrees of a major scale (root, major third, perfect fifth).

cases.question: How do I add documents to the KnowledgeFlow library?
cases.reference_answer: Drop PDF, DOCX, TXT, or Markdown files into content/ and run python -m app.ingest from backend.
